# Bronson Harrington, Growth Architect, Costa Rica

> Bronson Harrington is a Growth Architect based in San José, Costa Rica, with more than 25 years building organic growth systems in iGaming, fintech, legal and other regulated markets. A Growth Architect designs the system organic growth runs on (technical foundation, content and authority, and discovery across search engines and AI answer engines) instead of working through isolated SEO tasks. His method is Growth OS: Foundations, Growth, Domination.

This site is his personal site: field notes, builds (lab) and the Growth OS framework. Contact: im@bronson.co.za, +506 6182 5718.

## Core pages

- [Growth Architect, Costa Rica](https://bronson.co.za/growth-architect-costa-rica/): what a Growth Architect is, how it differs from SEO consulting, and the results behind Bronson Harrington's work. Canonical definition page.
- [Growth OS framework](https://bronson.co.za/framework/): the three-stage method (Foundations, Growth, Domination).
- [About Bronson Harrington](https://bronson.co.za/about-me/): background, roles and results (Betcris, JazzSports, BetAnySports and others).
- [Contact](https://bronson.co.za/contact/)
